situation: A new building is being constructed across the street from your home. For the past month, the work has started very early in the morning, and the noise is disturbing you and your family.
task: Write an email to your city's bylaw office in about 150-200 words. You are complaining about the construction noise.
points: Explain how it is affecting you and your family.
Suggest what the city should do about it.
sample:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about the noise from the construction site at 120 Maple Street, which is directly across the road from my home.

For the past month, the workers have been starting at about 5:30 in the morning, including on Saturdays. They use heavy machines and large trucks, and the noise continues without a break until the evening. As far as I know, construction in our city is not allowed before 7:00 a.m.

This situation has become very difficult for my family. My two young children are woken up every morning, so they are tired and cannot concentrate at school. My wife works night shifts at the hospital and is unable to sleep when she comes home. We cannot even open our windows because of the noise and dust.

I would like the city to send an officer to inspect the site and make sure the company follows the rules. I would also suggest that the loudest work be done only between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Yours faithfully,

Omar Hassan
